messages:
emma: opened PR to unify function-calling examples + migration notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/515

ryan: nice. can we add a tiny migration diff for integrators using old 'tools' key to new 'functions'? customers keep tripping on that.

emma: yes, adding a short diff and a one-paragraph 'what changed' at top. tasha, can you add the node SDK parseFallback snippet?

tasha: on it. will include a minimal fallback that logs telemetry and returns a safe object instead of throwing. also adding a tiny mocha snapshot that asserts examples parse.

omar: on schemas: avoid required on nested fields unless unavoidable. suggest using oneOf for payload variants and documenting validator behavior. also include an explicit malformed-response example so readers see how to recover.

emma: good call. i'll reword the guardrails to be pragmatic: schema + runtime checks + fallbacks + telemetry.

doc-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-515 \u2014 link-check queued (job 7999).

ryan: once CI + link-check pass we can merge. thanks team!
